name: cargomint-stack
description: One-command runner for CargoMint Logistics OS

scripts.start: npx concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run api" "npm run web"
scripts.full-stack: npx concurrently -n "API,WEB,CAP,CON" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold,yellow.bold,blue.bold" "npm run api" "npm run web" "npm run captain" "npm run consumer"

author: Antigravity
